landing.privacy_title: Your documents never stay with us
landing.privacy_subtitle: Privacy isn't a feature. It's the default.

privacy_items.title: Files deleted after processing
privacy_items.desc: The moment we finish reading your document, the original file is permanently deleted from our servers. We never store PDFs or photos — not even temporarily backed up.

privacy_items.title: We only extract what matters
privacy_items.desc: From each document, we extract: transaction dates, amounts, merchant names, document type, and policy details. We do not read or retain your address, ID numbers, or anything else.

privacy_items.title: Encrypted in transit
privacy_items.desc: All communication between your device and our server uses HTTPS. Your documents and data are never sent over an unencrypted connection.

privacy_items.title: Never sold, never shared
privacy_items.desc: Your financial data is yours. We do not sell it, share it with advertisers, or use it to train AI models. Ever.

onboarding.consent_body:
Save My Brain AI processes your documents using AI to extract summaries. Here's exactly what happens:

• Your documents are processed by Claude AI (Anthropic)
• After processing, original files are deleted — we keep summaries only
• Your data is never sold or used to train AI models
• You can delete your account and all data at any time

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Save My Brain AI is built by Santo Star Limited. We take privacy seriously — this policy explains exactly what we collect, what we do with it, and what rights you have.

collect.title: What we collect
collect.body: We collect: your name, email address, and Telegram ID (for account setup); documents you upload (PDFs, images, emails); calendar event metadata if you connect Google/Apple Calendar or Calendly; task and note data you enter; AI-generated summaries of your documents.

process.title: How we process your documents
process.body: When you upload a document, we send its contents to Claude AI (by Anthropic) to generate a plain-language summary. After processing, the original file is deleted from our servers. We store only the AI-generated summary. We do not store your originals after processing is complete.

ai.title: AI and third parties
ai.body: We use Claude AI (Anthropic) to process documents and answer your questions. Your document text is sent to Anthropic's API for this purpose. Anthropic's API does not use your data to train models — see Anthropic's privacy policy for details. We do not use any other third-party AI services. We do not use advertising networks or analytics services.

groups.title: Groups and sharing
groups.body: If you join a group, your group administrator can see: the number of documents you've uploaded, task status, and AI-generated summaries of your documents. They cannot see your original document files. Before joining a group, you will be shown exactly what your admin can access and asked to confirm.

retention.title: Data retention and deletion
retention.body: You can delete your account at any time from Settings → Account → Delete Account. This permanently deletes: all summaries, all tasks and notes, all calendar connections, and your profile. Deletion is immediate and irreversible. We retain anonymised aggregate statistics (total documents processed) but these cannot be linked back to you.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: Under Hong Kong's Personal Data (Privacy) Ordinance (PDPO) and Japan's Act on Protection of Personal Information (APPI), you have the right to: access all personal data we hold about you, correct inaccurate data, request deletion of your data, and object to processing. To exercise these rights, contact: privacy@santostar.com
